title: Influence of employers on employees’ family decisions: perspective of employees of Russian companies
core_idea: Assess how employers and corporate demographic policies can shape employees' family decisions by analyzing employees' perceptions gathered through a survey across 15 Russian regions; the study develops a measurement index of employers' positive influence and frames theoretical and empirical implications for corporate responsibility and demographic policy.
tldr: Investigates the potential role of businesses in addressing Russia’s demographic challenges by surveying employees about employer obligations and support, proposing an index to measure employer influence on family decisions, and outlining theoretical and empirical directions for corporate demographic policy.
